analysis.crux: The whole dispute reduces to one question: whether the carpet stain counts as chargeable damage (vs. ordinary wear). That is the single fact the kernel cannot — and will not — decide for you. Everything else above follows from your answer to it.
dissolved: The $500.00-vs-$450.00 gap is a number to correct, not a deception: the items simply add up to $450.00.

genuine_conflicts.description: Whether the carpet stain counts as chargeable damage (vs. ordinary wear) — a real disagreement of fact and judgment, not just different words.

ledger_findings: If the carpet stain counts as chargeable damage (vs. ordinary wear): the certified amount is $750.00. If not: $1050.00.
The stated figure of $500.00 is not what the itemization supports — the items total $450.00.
